title: CivEnhance — e-Service-Learning Matchmaking Platform
tagline: EU research platform that matches universities with rural community projects, built and deployed end to end.
description: A full-stack, API-driven platform for e-Service-Learning that connects universities, teachers and students with rural organisations. Built as sole developer: an Astro + React frontend, a Node.js/Express REST API and a PostgreSQL database, with role-based access control for four user types and a matchmaking engine based on Jaccard similarity. The API responds in 3–55 ms under production load. The platform supports 6 languages, meets WCAG accessibility standards, and is validated with Cypress end-to-end tests and deployed with Docker. A small FAQ assistant (keyword matching with an LLM fallback) complements the core platform.

title: Recommender System for Travel
tagline: Travel destination recommender driven by a conversational chatbot.
description: A recommender that suggests travel destinations from user preferences and a knowledge base. A chatbot gathers each user's interests and constraints, then returns destinations ranked by content-based filtering.

title: Spotify Replica
tagline: Desktop music player with user accounts, playlists and song uploads on a client-server architecture.
description: A Spotify-style desktop application in Java Swing, built on a client-server architecture with a relational SQL backend. Features user authentication, song uploads, playlist creation and management, and a multi-threaded audio engine.

title: Book Discussion Web Application
tagline: Book community platform with a REST API, discussion forums and user authentication.
description: A web platform for readers, built on a custom REST API with the Slim PHP framework and Twig templates. Includes session-based authentication, book search, threaded discussion forums and full CRUD operations on a relational SQL database.

title: HAL 9000 — Client-Server Music Streaming
tagline: Client-server music streaming service in C, built on sockets, threads, pipes and semaphores.
description: A distributed music streaming service written in C that reproduces real-world streaming constraints at the operating-system level. It uses POSIX sockets for network communication, threads for concurrent clients, named and unnamed pipes and POSIX message queues for inter-process messaging, and semaphores for synchronisation.

title: Limited-Slip Differential Controller (STM32F429I)
tagline: Real-time limited-slip differential controller on STM32, with a live Java dashboard.
description: Embedded software for the STM32F429I Discovery board that measures each wheel's speed and redistributes torque using accelerometer data, simulating a limited-slip differential. A companion Java application talks to the board over serial and shows speed, torque and differential state in real time.

title: Z Language Compiler
tagline: Complete compiler for a custom C-like language, from lexer to MIPS assembly.
description: A compiler for Z, a simplified C-like language with its own syntax (keywords such as bro, CEO, fact, swipe and throwback), written entirely in Java. The pipeline covers pre-processing, lexical analysis, a recursive-descent parser, semantic analysis with a symbol table, three-address intermediate code and MIPS assembly generation. Z supports integers, floats, arrays, recursive functions, conditionals, for/while loops and switch statements, with error recovery and descriptive diagnostics.

title: MDCS — ATM Banking Middleware
tagline: XFS middleware in C/C++ running on ~11,000 CaixaBank ATMs across Spain.
description: Maintenance and extension of the Device Control Software (MDCS) that runs on approximately 11,000 CaixaBank ATMs. MDCS implements the XFS (eXtensions for Financial Services) standard as Windows Service Providers, so ATM software can drive hardware from multiple vendors through a single standard interface. The work covers XFS v3.0–3.5 Service Providers for card readers, cash dispensers and PIN pads; JNI bridges between Java clients and C/C++ device drivers; efficiency-focused C++ with a minimal CPU and memory footprint; XMODEM remote firmware updates; Libtomcrypt PIN-block cryptography; NSIS deployment installers; and Doxygen API documentation.

title: Financial Monitoring & KPI Suite
tagline: Enterprise Java and Oracle suite processing 50–100k financial records a day for Banco Sabadell's ATM network.
description: A suite of enterprise Java applications (Java 8 and Java 21, Spring Boot) that collects, processes and visualises transaction data and KPIs for Banco Sabadell's ATM network, handling 50,000–100,000 financial records per day. It spans four subsystems: Recolectoras, the high-throughput collection engine (Java 8, Maven); Servicios and Portal, backend modules for ATM management and regulatory reporting; and ELAE (RecBsFj), a Spring Boot service for real-time event processing and alerting. Oracle performance is tuned with B-tree and Bitmap indexes and Materialized Views, and executive dashboards are built with AngularJS, D3.js and Apache ECharts.
